name: Smoke rolls across
text: Smoke rolls across the frame from the left.
desc: Threat arriving from off-screen. Fills the frame without moving the camera.
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds. Motion 2.327/1.535/3.407, above the ceiling 3/3, and smoke genuinely rolls in from frame left. TWO COSTS, both visible on 7701: it HALLUCINATED A SECOND PERSON - the head and shoulders of a man in a coat enter the foreground at f41 and then leave - and by f55 the smoke has obscured the subject. Fires reliably, damages the composition. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
